title: The explain_job faithfulness checker itself
notes: The deterministic half of `explain-faithfulness`. That suite needs a model and runs nightly; this one runs on every PR against 50 committed explanations (20 faithful, 30 with exactly one clause mutated) and asserts the post-generation checker catches every wrong one and refuses none of the faithful ones. Both floors are absolute: a missed fabrication reaches a student as fact, and a false refusal costs a student their explanation, so neither has an acceptable non-zero rate. `kind_attributed` is informational — it says whether the checker named the RIGHT fact, which decides whether the student is told something useful.
